summary: As SDDP Executive Director, Ahlers directed a May 2024 party statement acknowledging the Hamas Oct 7 attack while emphasizing over 30,000 Gaza civilian deaths and calling for continued pressure on Israel to end hostilities. The statement registers concern over Palestinian civilian harm and urges action against Israel but does not name the situation genocide, single out Israel as sole cause, or call for ending U.S. military support.
